jobs.title: Java - Full Stack Observability Engineer, AVP
jobs.description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are seeking a hands\-on Observability Engineer with strong full\-stack software engineering experience and deep expertise in Dynatrace. In this role, full stack means the ability to work across application code, telemetry instrumentation, observability platform configuration, dashboards, alerting, and automation workflows. The ideal candidate will help design, implement, and optimize observability solutions across enterprise SaaS and on\-premises environments, enabling proactive monitoring, faster root\-cause analysis, and automation\-assisted remediation. This position requires excellent communication, analytical, and technical skills, along with the ability to partner effectively with SaaS operations, product, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams.

  

  

**What you will be doing**

You will own and advance observability enablement for key Charles River services, including implementation standards, telemetry patterns, dashboards, alert quality, and adoption support. Working with SaaS, product, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams, you will design and implement tooling that improves visibility into service health, performance, availability, and client\-impacting issues. This role is critical to strengthening operational readiness and ensuring Charles River products can be monitored, observed, and proactively supported across client environments.

  

  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is part of the Charles River Investment Management Solution (CRIMS), a market\-leading end\-to\-end investment management platform covering front, middle, and back office capabilities. Charles River IMS supports portfolio management, compliance, order and execution management, post\-trade processing, data provisioning and management, performance measurement, and other capabilities central to the investment lifecycle. The Observability Engineer plays a key role in ensuring visibility into the performance, stability, and availability of the platform so teams can identify issues earlier, reduce operational risk, and improve the client experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Dynatrace implementation and optimization**

* Implement, configure, and optimize Dynatrace monitoring solutions across SaaS and on\-premises environments.
* Build and maintain Dynatrace Dashboards Gen 3 for unified visibility, executive reporting, and operational insights.
* Use Dynatrace SaaS, Grail, DQL, Davis AI, OneAgent, OpenTelemetry, synthetic monitoring, and real user monitoring where appropriate to improve observability coverage.
* Develop reusable implementation patterns and standards that enable consistent telemetry collection across critical services.
  

  

**Monitoring, alerting, and incident insight**

* Define log\-based alerts, service\-level indicators, trace\-log correlation, batch metrics, and alert\-quality standards for production services.
* Integrate Dynatrace with external systems, including Azure Event Hub or similar event\-publishing platforms, to support downstream workflows and operational reporting.
* Improve root\-cause analysis by correlating application, infrastructure, log, trace, metric, and user\-experience signals.
  

  

**Performance and reliability engineering**

* Conduct performance impact assessments using custom service detection rules, distributed traces, logs, and service health data.
* Partner with SRE, product, technical support, and engineering teams to ensure observability coverage for critical services and client\-facing workflows.
* Support automation\-assisted remediation by connecting observability insights to approved automation workflows where appropriate.
  

  

**Training, documentation, and enablement**

* Lead training sessions for SaaS, technical support, SRE, and engineering teams on Dynatrace usage, dashboard interpretation, and observability best practices.
* Develop documentation, onboarding materials, reference implementations, and dashboard templates for observability tools.
* Promote adoption of observability standards across teams by translating technical telemetry into actionable operational guidance.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12\+ years of experience designing, developing, implementing, or operating enterprise software systems and applications.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in observability, application performance monitoring, synthetic monitoring, telemetry instrumentation, dashboards, alerting, and trend analysis.
* Hands\-on experience with Dynatrace SaaS, DQL, Logs on Grail, Dashboards Gen 3, and related Dynatrace capabilities.
* Strong Java or JVM\-based engineering experience, including the ability to understand application behavior, instrumentation needs, and production performance characteristics.
* Experience with distributed systems, microservices, APIs, cloud\-native architectures, and production support practices.
* Experience with log ingestion, trace correlation, service detection, metrics, and real user monitoring.
* Ability to collaborate with engineering, SRE, SaaS operations, technical support, product, and client\-facing teams to translate observability data into actionable insight.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to both engineering and operational stakeholders.
  

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with React or other frontend frameworks, especially for frontend observability, real user monitoring, and user\-experience diagnostics.
* Experience with Azure Event Hub, Power BI, Grafana, Prometheus, or other visualization and telemetry platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containerized workloads, and data pipeline observability.
* Familiarity with automation, DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools and practices, including Terraform, Jenkins,…

jobs.title: Software Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high\-performing enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, React/Angular, and TypeScript
* Build and enhance microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud\-native solutions using modern software engineering practices
* Develop responsive and intuitive front\-end applications leveraging React, Angular, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript frameworks
* Design, develop, and integrate AI/ML\-enabled features including intelligent automation, predictive analytics, recommendation engines, and Generative AI solutions
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, data scientists, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Develop and consume APIs for seamless integration with enterprise systems, third\-party platforms, and AI/ML services
* Implement secure coding standards, application monitoring, performance tuning, and scalability improvements
* Build and deploy applications on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, utilizing containerization and Kubernetes
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and engineering best practice initiatives
* Support CI/CD pipelines, DevOps automation, infrastructure\-as\-code, and deployment optimization activities
* Work closely with AI/ML engineers to operationalize machine learning models and deploy AI services into production environments
* Leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI frameworks, prompt engineering techniques, and AI orchestration platforms to build intelligent solutions
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure platform reliability and availability
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement
* Drive adoption of emerging technologies, AI\-powered development tools, and modern software engineering practices
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
* 7\+ years of experience in Full Stack Application Development
* Hands\-on experience with React or Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or equivalent CI/CD tools
* Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, or Cosmos DB
* Experience integrating AI/ML services, cognitive APIs, or machine learning models into enterprise applications
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborating with cross\-functional teams
* Solid experience in Java 8/11/17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, and Microservices Architecture
* Knowledge of software design patterns, object\-oriented principles, and secure coding practices
* Understanding of Generative AI concepts, LLMs, RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation), Vector Databases, and Prompt Engineering
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native development across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform
* Familiarity with Python and AI/ML ecosystems such as Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Azure AI Services
* Demonstrated solid analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

jobs.title: Consumer & Shop Insights Assoc Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

India, one of PepsiCo’s core business regions, is focused on continuously building and developing its product portfolio in line with evolving consumer needs. To support this ambition, the business is seeking strong expertise and partnership from the S\&T India team. To meet this need, we are investing in a Subject Matter Expert who will be responsible for managing projects and delivering tailored learnings to the Business Unit.

  

The role will work closely with the Business Unit and key vendor partners to deliver reporting, analytics and day to day customer support. Based in Hyderabad, the role requires extensive experience in creative testing, brand health and innovation testing (Quantitative consumer research), along with strong project management and analytical capabilities.


The role will be critical in enhancing the impact and efficiency of these capabilities through knowledge sharing across ICC and PepsiCo markets, delivering ad hoc projects using available data, and developing compelling, actionable stories for the Business Unit.

  



Responsibilities:  

Functional Responsibilities:

* Work on project\-based report storytelling and recommendations – provide objective, expert perspective (“so what”, “why” and “what to do” synthesis) to Sector Insights teams in India.
* Build expertise in the ADA Creative, Innovation \& BBE Tools – methodology/interpretation and answer sector and BU questions and provide analytical support as needed
* Present some report sections under the supervision of a manager to key stakeholders in the insights team \+ support Insights team /present the results to the cross\-functional teams and business leaders where needed
* Work closely with other Insights team members to lift and shift internal best practices.


Stakeholder Management

* Address routine queries of stakeholders, requestors and end service users

  


Qualifications:  

* 5 \- 6 years Insights experience with prior experience in creative / innovation testing / brand health tracking \- preferably in a market research agency like Kantar, Ipsos or Nielsen.
* Existing research methodology knowledge, experience in giving actionable business recommendations based on learnings/synthesis of data.
* Strong communication and project management skills.
* Experience of working with global, regional and local insights professionals required


Communication

* Demonstrated skills with written communication – especially in PowerPoint and email
* Strong verbal and written communication – English


Project Management

* Highly analytical, motivated and decisive with excellent project management skills.
* Proven experience of planning and conducting research projects achieving goals and objectives
* Organized: Capable of juggling multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders, ensure delivery while proactively managing trade\-offs.


Execution

* Demonstrated ability to manage projects and overcome challenges
* Ability to run at least 40% \- 50% of consumer research analyses alone by leveraging various available data sources
* Ability to learn new tools quickly and start working in the different ways enabled by these tools (leverage the self\-serve platforms)

jobs.title: R-256479- Digital Product Manager (AI)
jobs.description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-256479 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 01, 2026 CATEGORY: Strategy and Innovation
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

  

  

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

  

  

**Digital Product Manager (AI)** The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.

  

  

**Role Overview**


We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI \& Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high\-potential AI and data\-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.
  

  

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross\-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.
  

  

This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.

  

  

**What You’ll Do**


* **Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability,** feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
* Identify, frame, and validate AI\-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.
* Assess how **LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics,** and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
* Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
* Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.
* Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.
* Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive\-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.
* **Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory** considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.
* **Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, prioritization discussions, technical feasibility reviews, user experience design, process mapping, and decision forums. Communicate complex AI and data concepts in a clear, business\-oriented way for senior leaders and non\-technical stakeholders.**

**Basic Qualifications:**


* 8\-13 years of work experience in the related field
* Doctorate; or Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* 4\+ years of product management, product strategy, innovation, consulting, digital transformation, or related experience.
* 2\+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of **AI product development**, **including discovery, prototyping, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.**
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.
* D…

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Cambridge Technology is seeking an experienced Marketing Manager to lead integrated marketing initiatives across all Cambridge brands, products, and digital properties. The role will be responsible for translating business priorities into cohesive marketing strategies that strengthen brand visibility, generate qualified leads, support product growth, and improve customer engagement.


This strategic and hands\-on position covers brand management, digital marketing, content, campaigns, social media, email marketing, events, lead generation, marketing analytics, and go\-to\-market execution. The Marketing Manager will collaborate with internal business, sales, product, design, content, and technology teams to establish priorities, guide execution, and ensure consistency across all marketing activities.

  

  

Key Responsibilities


* Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned with the company’s business, brand, product, and revenue objectives.
* Create and manage annual and quarterly marketing plans, campaign calendars, budgets, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Lead multi\-channel marketing campaigns across websites, email, social media, search, paid media, events, webinars, and other relevant channels.
* Develop go\-to\-market plans for new products, services, capabilities, and market initiatives, including positioning, messaging, launch plans, and sales\-enablement requirements.
* Maintain consistent brand positioning, messaging, tone, and visual standards across all Cambridge brands and customer\-facing communications.
* Oversee the planning and development of website content, blogs, social media posts, newsletters, case studies, presentations, videos, sales collateral, and other marketing materials.
* Work closely with sales and business teams to develop campaigns that generate, nurture, and convert qualified leads.
* Guide SEO, email marketing, social media, paid advertising, marketing automation, and website\-optimization activities.
* Monitor campaign and website performance using marketing and analytics platforms, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations.
* Present regular marketing performance reports covering campaign progress, digital engagement, website performance, lead generation, and key business outcomes.
* Conduct market, audience, competitor, and industry research to identify new opportunities and strengthen marketing strategy.
* Manage marketing projects from planning through completion, ensuring that deliverables meet quality, timeline, budget, and brand requirements.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders, external agencies, technology partners, and vendors involved in marketing execution.
* Establish marketing processes, approval workflows, documentation standards, and quality\-control practices.
* Provide direction, feedback, and quality oversight to marketing team members while supporting their professional development.
* Stay current with developments in digital marketing, AI\-enabled marketing, customer behavior, marketing technology, and competitive trends.
  

  

Required Qualifications


* 8–12 years of experience in marketing, including significant responsibility for integrated marketing strategy and campaign execution.
* Demonstrated experience managing marketing activities across multiple brands, products, services, or business units.
* Strong understanding of brand management, digital marketing, content marketing, email campaigns, social media, SEO, paid media, lead generation, events, and marketing automation.
* Experience developing and executing go\-to\-market strategies for technology products, services, or B2B solutions.
* Strong ability to translate business objectives into actionable marketing plans, campaigns, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, timelines, resources, agencies, vendors, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using campaign, website, CRM, and lead\-generation data to guide decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, stakeholder\-management, and project\-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Experience leading or mentoring marketing professionals and reviewing the quality of marketing deliverables.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  

  

Tools and Platforms


* The successful candidate should have experience with major marketing, analytics, CRM, content, and campaign\-management platforms, including several of the following:
* CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot, Salesforce, Salesforce Account Engagement, or comparable platforms.
* Analytics and reporting: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and native social and advertising analytics.
* Email and lead generation: HubSpot, Apollo.io, Mailchimp, or comparable email marketing and sales\-engagement platforms.
* Paid and social media: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, and other relevant advertising platforms.
* SEO and competitive intelligence: Semrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Google Trends, and related research tools.
* Content and website management: Webflow, WordPress, or comparable content\-management systems.
* Project management and collaboration: Asana, Jira, monday.com, Trello, Microsoft Teams, or comparable platforms.
* Design and content collaboration: Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar platforms.

jobs.title: Campaign Executive
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**


Cambridge Technology is seeking an experienced Email Marketing \& Campaign Manager to plan, manage, and execute email campaigns across all Cambridge brands, products, and target audiences. This contractor will own the complete campaign lifecycle from campaign strategy, audience selection, and scheduling through automation, deployment, optimization, and performance reporting.


The role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking and hands\-on campaign management. The selected candidate will work with internal marketing, content, design, product, sales, and technology teams to deliver relevant, timely, and compliant email communications that strengthen engagement, support lead generation, and contribute to business growth.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Develop and manage the email marketing strategy and campaign calendar across all Cambridge brands, products, and business priorities.
* Manage end\-to\-end execution of newsletters, product promotions, lead\-nurturing programs, event campaigns, cold\-outreach campaigns, customer communications, and re\-engagement campaigns.
* Define campaign objectives, target audiences, segmentation criteria, messaging requirements, schedules, workflows, and calls to action.
* Build, configure, test, schedule, and deploy email campaigns using relevant email marketing and marketing automation platforms.
* Create automated workflows, nurture sequences, drip campaigns, lead\-scoring logic, triggers, and lifecycle\-based communication programs.
* Manage contact segmentation, suppression lists, subscription preferences, consent records, data quality, duplicate records, and campaign eligibility rules.
* Conduct A/B and multivariate testing across subject lines, sender names, content, calls to action, layouts, timing, and audience segments.
* Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, identify improvement opportunities, and provide clear recommendations and reports to internal stakeholders.
* Manage email deliverability by monitoring sender reputation, bounce rates, spam complaints, domain authentication, inbox placement, and engagement quality.
* Ensure campaigns comply with applicable email marketing and data privacy requirements, including CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, consent management, and unsubscribe regulations.
* Maintain campaign documentation, naming conventions, templates, quality\-control checklists, approval processes, and reporting standards.
* Stay current with changes in email marketing technology, automation practices, privacy regulations, deliverability standards, and AI\-enabled campaign optimization.

**Required Qualifications**


* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience in email marketing, campaign management, marketing automation, or a related digital marketing role.
* Demonstrated experience managing the complete lifecycle of B2B email campaigns across multiple brands, products, audiences, or markets.
* Strong knowledge of campaign planning, audience segmentation, personalization, marketing automation, lead nurturing, and customer lifecycle communications.
* Hands\-on experience building, testing, deploying, and optimizing campaigns using leading email marketing and automation platforms.
* Strong understanding of email deliverability, sender reputation, bounce management, spam prevention, domain authentication, and inbox\-placement practices.
* Working knowledge of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, subscription management, consent requirements, and applicable email marketing regulations.
* Experience with A/B testing, campaign analytics, attribution, reporting, and translating performance data into actionable recommendations.
* Strong project management, attention to detail, problem\-solving, and internal stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, audience segments, and business priorities simultaneously.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Tools and Platforms**


The successful candidate should have hands\-on experience with leading email marketing, CRM, automation, analytics, and campaign\-quality platforms, including several of the following:


* Email marketing and automation: HubSpot, Mailchimp, Adobe Marketo Engage, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Account Engagement, Klaviyo, Brevo, or comparable platforms.
* Lead generation and sales engagement: Apollo.io, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar platforms.
* CRM and contact management: HubSpot CRM, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or comparable CRM systems.
* Analytics and reporting: Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, native campaign\-reporting tools, and spreadsheet\-based reporting.
* Email testing and quality assurance: Litmus, Email on Acid, or comparable email preview and testing tools.
* Deliverability and domain monitoring: Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, MXToolbox, and related reputation\-monitoring tools.
* Project and campaign management: Asana, Jira, monday.com, Trello, or comparable project\-management platforms.

jobs.description:

* India
* Product Management
* Mid\-Senior Level
* Onsite


  
**The Opportunity**
-------------------


Coupa makes margins multiply through its community\-generated AI and industry\-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M\+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.


**Why join Coupa?**


* **Pioneering Technology:** At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
* **Collaborative Culture:** We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
* **Global Impact:** Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.


**The Impact of Sr. Product Manager to Coupa:**


As Sr. Product Manager in the Supply Chain Optimization team, you’ll evolve, define, and build innovative, differentiating and profitable products by leveraging your industry experience and engagement with forward\-thinking customers. This role is to own the supply chain extensibility platform. This includes the Supply Chain Compose product that is used to extend the core product to allow all stakeholders to access supply chain optimization capabilities via prescriptive workflows.

**Description**


**Who is USP?**


The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.


USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.


**Brief Job Overview**


This position is a global, nonsupervisory position in the Strategic Insights (SI) department within the Legal, Strategy and People division at the U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP). As part of the SI department, the Insights team performs a centralized market research function for USP – supporting all levels of the organization including the Executive Team.


The role functionally and administratively reports to India\-based Sr. Insights Manager – Primary Research. The role is responsible for supporting organizational understanding of the USP’s customers and business environment and advocating for needed resources. This role manages complex, high level research projects to help decision\-makers better understand stakeholders, customers, markets and trends through primary research techniques and consulting outreach. The position’s scope encompasses in\-depth organizational knowledge of USP’s Public Health Programs, including official standards publications, reference standards, communications, pharmacopeial education, verification, advocacy, and other products and services to facilitate sound decision making.

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.


Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

* Represents the Strategic Insights department with poise and professionalism
* Performs other related duties as required

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Global HealthX**




  





 Global HealthX is on a mission to reshape how people experience healthcare. We build products that
 



 touch real patients and providers, in a market that is early, enormous, and moving fast. We are past the"will this work" stage and squarely in the "how big can this get" stage which means whoever joins
 



 now gets to shape the product, the roadmap, and the culture while the story is still being written.
 



  





**About Healix Engage**




  





 Healix Engage is our patient and provider engagement platform — the layer that turns healthcare
 



 interactions into ongoing, meaningful relationships. It is a product with real users, real traction, and a
 



 roadmap far larger than the team currently chasing it. There is white space here that most PMs only
 



 dream about: core problems still to be solved, and the freedom to solve them well.
 



  





**The Role**




  





 We are looking for a Product Manager to own Healix Engage end to end. This is not a backloggrooming, ticket\-shuffling role. You will set direction, make the hard calls on what gets built and what does not, and be accountable for outcomes not just output. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and leadership, with unusual latitude to run experiments, kill bad ideas quickly, and double down on what is working.
 



 If you have been the PM who quietly does the strategic thinking while someone senior takes the
 



 meeting this is your chance to take the meeting.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  




* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Healix Engage, and translate it into a sequence of releases that compound.
* Talk to users constantly patients, providers, internal teams and turn what you hear into sharp product decisions.
* Define the problems worth solving, write crisp specs, and partner with engineering and design to ship fast without shipping sloppy.
* Use data to decide. Set the metrics that matter, instrument them, and let the numbers not opinions settle debates.
* Prioritize ruthlessly against limited time and resources the hallmark of a great PM at a growing company.
* Be the connective tissue across teams, keeping everyone aligned on the "why" and the "what's next."



  





**What We're Looking For**




  




* Roughly 3–5 years in product management, ideally including time taking a product from early to scaling (0→1 or 1→10 experience is a big plus).
* A track record of shipping products that moved real metrics you can point to specific outcomes you are proud of.
* Strong product intuition paired with genuine comfort in data; you can zoom from strategy to a Figma detail to a SQL query and back.
* Excellent judgment under ambiguity. You make good decisions with incomplete information and course\-correct quickly.
* Clear, persuasive communication you can align a room and write a spec that does not need a translator.
* A builder's temperament: high ownership, low ego, and a bias for action. You would rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for perfect.



  





 Bonus: experience in healthcare, health\-tech, or another regulated, high\-trust domain.

jobs.description:
**Description**
 The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech on the DSP\-DA LifeCycle Management (DALCM) team owns the end\-to\-end product strategy and execution for the critical milestones in the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Delivery Associate (DA) lifecycle, including onboarding, off\-boarding, qualifications management, and status management across Amazon's global transportation network. The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last\-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000\+ Delivery Associates.
   

  

 This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off\-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off\-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi\-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
   

  

 We are in the early stages of a multi\-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next\-generation experience looks like.
   

  

 This is a global role requiring cross\-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one\-way and two\-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post\-launch, the Sr. Product Manager\-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface\-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager\-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
   

  

 We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long\-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Leading the build\-out of new external facing applications, products, features and tools.
* Owning the translation of business intent, customer needs, and/or technical direction into clear, concise, well\-documented business requirements or product backlog for one or more complex applications (or a product family) spanning one or more technical domains.
* Developing longer\-term (12 months or more) product roadmap, ensuring product development plans align with and support stakeholder business and application objectives.
* Communicate and collaborate cross\-functionally across multiple teams in operations, technology and planning to define strategic roadmaps while keeping the impact of the solution to all stakeholders in mind
* Creating and implementing data driven improvements to Amazon's transportation network
* Monitoring KPI’s to analyze their drivers and determine the level of investment needed


**About The Team**
 The team consists of engineers, product managers, and program managers. These functions roll up into a shared VP with a shared goal of delivering the most efficient experience for our transportation partners.

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 5\+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning

**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role summary:**
 This is an inbound technical product manager role. You'll own the design and delivery of ServiceNow's ITSM and ITOM products — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and CMDB — in a live production environment, measure how they actually perform, and use that evidence to influence what the products should become.
   

  

 Three things make this role distinct from a standard implementation specialist:
   

  

* You own the outcome, not the deployment. Go\-live is the midpoint. You instrument the solution, track adoption and performance in production, and iterate when the data says the design didn't land.

 Business Analyst
 



**Department** 




 Product \& Delivery

 Hybrid (Flexible)
 



**Employment Type** 




 Full\-Time, Permanent

 Requirements Engineering \& Voice AI Solution Delivery
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and delivery\-focused Business Analyst to join a growing product organization building next\-generation conversational AI solutions for the financial services industry. In this role, you will act as the bridge between business, compliance, engineering, and client stakeholders — translating regulated, domain\-heavy business needs into clear, actionable requirements for a voice AI platform. You will own requirement lifecycle activities across discovery, design, delivery, and post\-launch iteration, and help shape a product that operates at the intersection of generative AI, contact\-center telephony, and stringent regulatory obligations.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Requirements Engineering \& Business Analysis** 



* Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for conversational AI, voice, and contact\-center automation solutions through workshops, interviews, and process observation.

**Domain \& Regulatory Alignment**

**Position Overview**  

  

The **Experienced Product Owner** is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end\-to\-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands\-on domain mastery role. You are the subject\-matter expert, the decision\-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi\-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the **Total Rewards: Compensation \& Advance Compensation** Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Domain Ownership \& Functional Mastery**

  

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): **Compensation \& Advance Compensation** end\-to\-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI\-powered tools, third\-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

 **PortCo Engagement \& Stakeholder Management**

  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade\-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

 **Roadmap \& Release Ownership**

  

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo\-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.

 **Hands\-On Delivery**

* Own day\-to\-day delivery.

 **Ecosystem \& Innovation Thinking**

  

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

 **Required Qualifications**

  

* 5\+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands\-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Nice to have experience working in a multi\-entity, multi\-PortCo, or shared\-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi\-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

 **Module\-specific Experience (by Role): Compensation \& Advanced Compensation**  

  

Salary structures, merit and bonus planning, compensation cycles, and global pay practices — configuration and operational support.

* **Compensation Structures:** Grade profiles, salary ranges, pay bands, compensation plans (salary, hourly, allowance), and eligibility rules.
* **Merit \& Bonus Planning:** Merit matrices, bonus plan configuration, target amounts, proration rules, and manager worksheet setup.
* **Compensation Cycles:** Annual and off\-cycle review configuration, approval routing, budget pools, and cycle administration.
* **Advanced Compensation:** Long\-term incentive plans, equity award management, one\-time payments, and complex plan eligibility.

jobs.description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  

**Must have skills :** Automotive Digital Cockpit Solutions  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

The senior individual contributor backbone of the team. Owns one or more VHAL components end to end — design, implementation, test, integration and field defect ownership with minimal supervision. Acts as the go\-to person for a technical domain (for example, HVAC and body properties, power management signalling, or the SOME or IP bridge) and mentors engineers.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

  

Implementation \& Ownership:  

* Implement VHAL property support end to end: define the VehiclePropConfig (access mode, change mode, area configs, min or max, supported enum values), wire the read or write path, implement subscription and change\-notification, and handle StatusCode error paths and VehiclePropertyStatus (AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE or ERROR).
* Implement and maintain the connector layer between VHAL and the vehicle bus: SocketCAN readers, SOME or IP event subscriptions and method calls, or the proprietary IPC to a companion controller.
* Extend the Car Framework where required: new CarPropertyManager conveniences, vendor CarManager implementations, permission definitions and SystemApi annotations, car\-lib changes and their api or .txt updates.
* Write emulator or reference support so features can be developed without hardware: extend the AOSP reference VHAL (fake VHAL), property\-injection tooling, and mock signal generators.
* Own performance and resource characteristics of the components: profile the hot paths, eliminate redundant copies across the Binder boundary, tune subscription rates.

  

Debugging \& Root Cause:\-  

* Lead root\-cause analysis on complex defects spanning app , CarService ,VHAL , bus, using dumpsys, logcat, systrace or perfetto, bugreport, CAN traces and SOME or IP captures.
* Reproduce and triage field or vehicle\-fleet issues drive fixes through to OTA.

  

Quality:\-  

* Write unit tests (GTest or GMock for native, JUnit or Robolectric or Mockito for framework), VTS tests for the HAL surface, and instrumentation tests where a device is required.
* Author the SELinux policy for owned services and resolve denials correctly — scoping to the narrowest type and permission set.
* Review peers' code enforce the team's coding standards and API\-compatibility rules.

  

Mentoring:\-  

* Onboard and coach engineers on AOSP workflows, VHAL concepts and debugging technique.
* Contribute to design reviews for adjacent components and challenge designs constructively.

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* 8\+ years total, 3\+ years in Android platform or automotive embedded systems, including hands\-on VHAL or HAL\-layer work.
* Proficient\-to\-advanced C\+\+ (14 or 17\): STL, smart pointers, templates at a practical level, multithreading with mutexes or condition variables, understanding of the AIDL NDK backend (ndk:ScopedAStatus, AIBinder, SharedRefBase).
* Strong Java competent Kotlin (coroutines, null\-safety, interop with Java framework code).
* Solid grasp of Android internals: Binder IPC, ServiceManager, system services, init and .rc files, SELinux basics, system or vendor or product partition rules, HIDL vs AIDL HAL differences, VINTF.
* Working knowledge of the Car API surface: VehiclePropertyIds, VehicleAreaSeat or VehicleAreaZone, CarPropertyValue, property permissions (Car.PERMISSION), and the vendor\-permission mechanism.
* Practical experience with at least one onboard network: CAN or CAN\-FD with DBC signal decoding, LIN, or Automotive Ethernet with SOME or IP.
* Able to read and interpret SOME or IP service interface definitions and configure a vsomeip client (routing manager, service discovery, endpoint config).
* Comfortable in an AOSP tree: repo sync, Android.bp authoring, target builds, incremental module builds, adb sync or adb remount workflows.
* C\+\+. Java, Kotlin, Rust, Python or Bash

  

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in Automotive Digital Cockpit Solutions.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

Jira Service Management (JSM) was recently recognized as 'Leader in the Forrester WaveTM', and the team continues to drive forward our mission of becoming the service management tool for all teams. Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

* **Work on end\-to\-end experiences.** We want you to focus on end\-to\-end experiences rather than individual features. You’ll be contributing to experiences across all design phases, from problem definition and research through to prototyping and UI implementation. If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Assistant Manager Product Control.**

 **Purpose of the role:**


This role sits within the Intercompany/Intracompany Derivative Reconciliation Team and focuses on delivering accurate, timely reconciliations and effective issue resolution across intercompany/intracompany derivative portfolios. As an individual contributor, you’ll act as the SME for your assigned processes and portfolios, owning reconciliations end\-to\-end, applying structured problem\-solving to resolve complex breaks, and partnering closely with stakeholders to drive timely closure and strengthen reconciliation controls.

 **In this role, you will:**

* To act as an individual contributor delivering daily business controls (Reconciliation and Manual Journals) pertaining to the Global Markets business. Ensure delivery service of Accounting Control \- Operations processes as per the standards set out in agreed SLAs within the HSBC Global Resourcing operating framework.
* Assist with production of reconciliations, investigation \& root cause analysis of breaks including accounting adjustments to be posted to the books \& records.
* Produce accurate and timely management information in conjunction with the In\-country/near shore teams ensuring the queries pertaining to deliverables are promptly responded with active business engagement.
* Provide assistance to the Assistant Vice President in day\-to\-day and periodic reporting requirements and provide leave and off\-days cover for other team members. Identify opportunities for improvements. Participate in strategic and tactical change projects undertaken in respective businesses.
* Perform in\-depth impact assessment of proposed changes on processes, data and systems and formally document. Plan and schedule project activities aligned with the project plan and ensure timely completion of milestones.
* Manage stakeholder relationships with In\-country teams / Near\-shore teams, IT teams. Collaborate within the team to and mentor new team members as requested by manager. Provide excellent stakeholder management by ensuring that reconciliations are being provided within the required SLA and break investigation and RCA’s are up to date.
* Process specialist \- to support and guide the team and act as a key referral point for escalation for junior team members. Develop realistic and achievable strategies and action plans to address performance gaps, training and staffing requirements.
* Help your immediate manager in implementing and communicating the group targets. Set the right example to junior members of the team. Create an environment within the team which fosters free sharing of knowledge \& ideas.
* Prepare and Update Business Contingency Plan (BCP) for Operations Teams. Be aware of issues within teams. All issues / problems are fully analyzed and resolved or escalated in appropriate and timely manner.
* Maintains HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.

 **To be successful you will:**

* Accounting designation is preferred or with 4\+ years of total experience in accounting, banking or similar finance roles.
* Graduate degree in Accounting, Finance Management, Commerce or related degree in Finance.
* Relevant experience in a global bank or related operational experience in an organization of similar scale.
* Experience in complex reconciliations across multiple systems and platforms would be preferred
* Preferably experience will cover reconciliation of traded financial instruments and products such as foreign exchange, fixed income, and equities.
* Strong IT skills, particularly MS Excel and MS Access. Strong time management skills
* Excellent communication and presentation skills as the role requires regular interaction with regional teams within the HSBC Group
* Readiness to work in shift hours in different time zones and travel as the business requires.

 **You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

**www.hsbc.com/careers**


HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Manager, Product Management — Sourcing \& Procurement**


**Zora AI™ by Deloitte \| Deloitte Consulting Products (USI)**


**About the Role**


Zora AI™ by Deloitte is Deloitte's agentic AI platform, delivering role\- and function\-specific products — including Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Customer, and Human Capital — built on the NVIDIA AI stack and underpinned by Deloitte's Trustworthy AI™ framework.


Deloitte is looking for a hands\-on Product Manager to own the **Sourcing \& Procurement product area** within Zora AI end\-to\-end. Based in US\-India (USI Office), you'll own the roadmap, the team, and the outcomes for a defined slice of the procurement portfolio — spanning requisitioning, sourcing and RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding and collaboration, and purchase\-to\-pay — turning real practitioner pain points into digital workers that deliver measurable value. You'll set direction in partnership with the Product Lead, run discovery and delivery across multiple workstreams, and bring deep procurement domain expertise to every decision, all while ensuring trust, adoption, and business impact for enterprise users.


This is a builder's role with real ownership: you're accountable not just for what your team ships, but for the vision, prioritization, and people behind it. You'll work closely with US\-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and you'll mentor and grow the Consultants and Analysts around you.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Own Your Product**


* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for the Sourcing \& Procurement product area, and take a lead role — alongside the Product Lead — in shaping the 12–18 month vision and strategy
* Make prioritization and trade\-off calls across multiple workstreams (requisition, sourcing/RFx, contract management, supplier onboarding, purchase\-to\-pay), sequencing by value, effort, and readiness
* Define and own the KPIs that prove impact: adoption, efficiency gains, cost reduction, supplier performance, and workflow completion
* Know when something isn't working — flag it early, make the case to change course, and retire low\-value work fast

**Discover \& Validate**


* Lead discovery to understand procurement practitioners, category managers, and finance stakeholders, and translate what you hear into prioritized, high\-value use cases
* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and competitive analysis of procurement platforms before committing to build at scale
* Use generative and evaluative research to continuously answer "are we building the right thing?" and "are we building it right?"

**Ship as One Team**


* Take features and agent capabilities from concept through define, shape, build, and scale
* Own PRDs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow diagrams for agent behaviors, tool use, human\-in\-the\-loop patterns, and exception handling across your product area
* Run sprint planning, reviews, and the daily cadence that keeps delivery moving with engineering, data science, and design
* Own launch, adoption, and iteration — instrument the product and act on what the telemetry and voice\-of\-customer data show
* Work in an AI\-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery

**Trust \& Governance**


* Partner with risk, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to define evaluation approach, monitoring plans, auditability, and governance requirements aligned to the Trustworthy AI™ framework
* Own trust and audit\-readiness outcomes for your product area, including policy adherence and reduction of high\-severity model risks

**Clients \& Go\-to\-Market**


* Stay close to clients — lead demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations with procurement leaders and category managers, and turn what you hear into roadmap decisions
* Own go\-to\-market inputs for your area: positioning, pricing/packaging input, demos, and enablement, partnering with sales, alliances, and delivery on pursuits, pilots, and launches
* Stay fluent in the market realities shaping procurement products: data privacy, ERP/CRM ecosystems, connector marketplaces, and SaaS vs. on\-prem considerations

**Work Across the Network \& Lead the Team**


* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align the product area with delivery capacity and real client needs
* Mentor and develop the Consultants and Analysts on your team, raising the bar on product craft, and act as the go\-to escalation point for your product area
* Collaborate with Sourcing \& Procurement SMEs to collect product feedback and establish an advisory council

**Key Deliverables**


* Owned roadmap and delivery for the Sourcing \& Procurement product area, with direct input into broader portfolio strategy
* PRDs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria across all agent capabilities in your area
* Use\-case catalog and prioritization framework (value, feasibility, risk, readiness)
* MVP/pilot plans with success metrics, rollout phases, and scale criteria
* Trust \& governance artifacts: evaluation approach, monitoring plan, audit/logging requirements
* Release plans and launch\-readiness inputs (docs, training, demo scripts, enablement)
* Customer feedback loop: telemetry dashboards, voice\-of\-customer insights, iteration plan
* Development plans and coaching cadence for direct reports/mentees

**How Success Will Be Measured**

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Alexa Smart Properties
jobs.description:
**Description**
 The vision for Alexa is to be the world’s best personal assistant. Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. We’re leveraging Generative AI to reimagine how hospitality, healthcare, senior living, and other verticals deliver magical experiences to their guests, patients, residents, and staff.
   

  

 If you’re passionate about building enterprise\-grade communication and device management solutions — while applying GenAI to solve hard, complex technical problems — then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, content management systems, third party integrations , and enterprise SaaS platforms to deliver delightful, scalable features for our B2B customers and their end users.
   

  

 Come join us to invent the future of how millions of enterprise end users communicate and connect through Alexa\-powered devices — and how businesses manage those experiences at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Senior Product Manager — Technical in Alexa Smart Properties, you will own and drive the product vision and execution for our enterprise staff personas to make it easy for staff to manage their content, get real time insights, and engage with their end customers. You will own our enterprise console and integrations with third party systems. You will manage how staff manage content in our enterprise console including menus, events, promotions, alerts, and contacts. You will create features to deliver staff real time insights \- through intelligent real time events to analytics. You will also build out capabilities to track tickets, orders, and other tasks directly in our enterprise console.
   

  

 With Alexa Smart Properties, you can also manage your content and end customer engagement using a third party system such as a property management system or resident engagement system. You will manage the roadmap of integrations we develop as well as improvements to accelerate integration speed and scale.
   

  

 Across both pillars, you will use all means possible — including AI capabilities — to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation. You will leverage GenAI to rapidly generate prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster. You will deeply understand your product’s business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing strategy, and profitability drivers — and articulate how product decisions impact business outcomes.
   

  

 You will define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statements, tenets, and strategy while owning roadmap and priorities. You will influence without authority, building alignment across teams with different priorities — engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, sales, legal, and operations. You will establish key performance indicators, drive feature adoption, and measure the health of your product and business, distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You will create buy\-in for your vision across the Alexa organization and with external partners, and conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and competitive analysis to identify best\-of\-breed benchmarks and understand market opportunities.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Sr. PMT in Alexa Smart Properties, rarely are two days the same. You are a business owner, the voice of the customer, and the point person for partner teams across communication and device management experiences.
   

  

 On a daily basis, you will be working with enterprise customers to understand the needs of the staff persona \- including needs to manage content, engagement with end customers, and get real\-time insights. Your day could consist of writing PRFAQs and BRDs, building a prioritized roadmap, sprint planning/bug bashing, iterating on product decisions with Engineering teams, evaluating how GenAI and agentic systems can accelerate your roadmap, working with partners in business development, solution architects, legal, privacy, documentation, and more. You will think big to envision what’s next for enterprise communications, and exhibit “Learn and Be Curious” for different technologies — including emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

 You will make informed trade\-offs, build your own mockups and prototypes, define acceptance criteria, and participate in testing and validation. You’ll evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses — including extensibility, performance, and scalability — asking the right questions to identify risks before commitments are made. You’ll assess how AI capabilities can reshape product architectures, when autonomous agent patterns enhance versus complicate product design, and how to leverage GenAI to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment. You will use AI on a daily basis to increase your velocity and scale your impact.
   

  

 You will meet with customers to understand our core strengths and weaknesses, synthesize feedback with business and service data, and drive decisions using sophisticated judgment when data is incomplete. People will look to you to solve problems, connect them with specialists, and hold the tension between business outcomes and customer value honestly.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing …

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (B2B)
jobs.description:
**About Refold AI** 




  





 Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants. 
 



  





 We've grown rapidly, reaching seven\-figure ARR and 30\+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.
 



  





 Refold AI has raised $6\.5M from world\-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb \& Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




  




* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours? You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.



  





**What we're looking for:** 




  




* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade\-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade\-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two\-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made



  





**Experience** 




  




* 5\+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top\-tier institution, or hands\-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.
