 Backed by industry giants like Bajaj Auto and Magna International, Yulu operates at the intersection of mobility, technology, and sustainability. Our mission is to reduce congestion, cut emissions, and transform how India moves — one ride at a time.
 



 With millions of rides completed, thousands of EVs on the road, and a rapidly expanding footprint, we’re not just building EVs — we’re building the future of urban mobility in India.
 



 🔗 Learn more: www.yulu.bike
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 As a Product Manager at Yulu, you will own the product experience for gig workers who rely on Yulu for their daily mobility, from the rental journey to battery swaps. Your goal is to make every ride seamless, reliable, and cost\-efficient so gig workers can maximize their earnings. Working with engineering, data science, business, and operations, you will use user insights, real\-time analytics, and AI\-driven optimization to improve gig worker satisfaction and retention.
 



 If you thrive on solving real\-world user pain points, improving financial outcomes for gig workers, and building scalable mobility solutions, join us in shaping the future of electric last\-mile mobility!
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Product Strategy \& Roadmap** 



* Own the gig worker journey end\-to\-end, from rental to battery swaps, removing friction at every step.
* Define the product vision and strategy for the gig worker experience, grounded in user insights and business goals.
* Build and prioritize the roadmap around measurable outcomes: gig worker earnings, satisfaction, and retention.
* Drive products from ideation to launch and scale, iterating continuously on what the data and the field show.



**Collaboration \& Execution** 



* Own Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), integrating insights from engineering, business, and customer support, and socialize them to align teams on scope and expectations.
* Work with founders and cross\-functional teams in a matrix setup, balancing stakeholder needs to deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Act as a product advocate, articulating product value and upcoming enhancements, and run demos to drive adoption and gather feedback.
* Proactively address roadmap bottlenecks, working with the team to ensure seamless execution and the achievement of product goals.



**Innovation \& Growth** 



* Identify and drive new product ideas and enhancements from user and stakeholder insights.
* Scale the gig worker experience as Yulu expands into new cities and markets.



**Metrics \& Insights** 



* Set OKRs and success metrics for the gig worker experience, and review them regularly with the team.
* Measure the impact of every launch, using experiments and funnel analysis across the rental and battery swap journeys to decide what to build next.
* Spend regular time in the field with gig workers and ops teams, combining what you see with support and usage data to find the biggest pain points.
* Flag risks early and drive solutions to complex problems.



  





**Key Requirements** 



* B.Tech / MBA or equivalent practical experience in product management.
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Management, with a proven track record of delivering impactful products.
* Experience building consumer\-facing mobile products used daily at scale, ideally in mobility, logistics, quick\-commerce, or on\-demand delivery.
* Ability to define, track, and drive product outcomes through clear metrics, OKRs, and data\-led decisions.
* Hands\-on use of AI tools in daily product workflows, from input collection and research to documentation and prototyping.
* A habit of spending time in the field with gig workers and ops teams, turning direct user insights into product decisions.
* Deep ownership and a strong sense of urgency, with the ability to drive initiatives from ideation to execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A collaborative and open culture where your ideas and opinions are valued.
* Challenging and rewarding problem statements that deepen your understanding of Product Management.
* A dynamic and growth\-driven journey that pushes you to learn, innovate, and excel.

jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
 The
 **Senior Product Owner** 
 is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end\-to\-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands\-on domain mastery role. You are the subject\-matter expert, the decision\-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi\-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform.
   

  

 This role is specifically focused on Core HCM, Onboarding \& Security. Additional module expertise is a plus. This role has a defined growth path: as the team matures, the Product Owner will take on line management responsibility for an Associate Product Owner, growing into a player\-manager who both delivers and develops.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Domain Ownership \& Functional Mastery**
* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Core HCM, Security and Onbaording end\-to\-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.

At Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) we strive to do just this. We work tirelessly to ensure we have the appropriate strategy, technology, and attitude to be successful. This BA role will primarily support the data and reporting needs for the Safety Performance Insights (SPI) BI team in the WHS Organization. The role requires BA to identify the metrics and the dimensions that provide deep insights into program performance and also partner closely with the business to define the scope and the roadmap for the analysis, with an eye on both short term asks and long terms needs from a BI standpoint. This role requires to partner closely with Data Engineering teams to design the required data assets and where needed to partner with other business teams to study the cross\-effects of safety programs on other business areas and processes.

jobs.description:
**About Autonomize AI**
 Autonomize AI is revolutionizing healthcare by combining data and context to streamline knowledge workflows, reduce administrative burdens, and improve patient outcomes. We’re a high\-velocity, mission\-driven startup that values full\-stack ownership, clear alignment, and customer obsession.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We’re hiring a
 **Jr Business Analyst** 
 to translate complex healthcare workflows into clear requirements and AI\-enabled solutions. You’ll work directly with customers to understand current processes, identify opportunities for automation, design future\-state workflows, and own requirements from discovery through delivery.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Project Managers, Solution Architects, Clinical SMEs, QA, Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams. You don’t need to be a developer or ML engineer, but you should be technically curious, comfortable with AI\-enabled products, and experienced using modern AI tools to improve how you work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Discovery \& Requirements**
* Lead customer and internal discovery sessions to understand business objectives, workflows, pain points, business rules, exceptions, and success criteria.
* Translate findings into clear BRDs, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, current/future\-state workflows, and solution mockups that communicate the intended experience to customers and technical teams.
* Document the client applications involved in each workflow, including what is read or written, and produce field\-level data mappings to hand off to Solution Architects for integration design.
* Decompose complex healthcare processes (including areas such as UM, Prior Authorization, Appeals \& Grievances, Care Management, claims, and clinical workflows) into clear, automatable steps.
* Work with Clinical SMEs to validate clinical rules, criteria, and edge cases on clinical use cases.
* Create process maps using tools such as Mural, Lucidchart, Visio, or similar platforms and drive open questions and requirements through resolution.


**AI \& Technical Fluency**
* Identify where rules, automation, and AI can each improve a workflow, and propose human\-in\-the\-loop steps where judgment or review is needed, working with Solution Architects to finalize the approach. Understand concepts such as LLMs, OCR, RAG, extraction, and classification.
* Use various AI and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, workflow design, and other day\-to\-day work.
* Understand technical concepts such as APIs, SFTP/file exchange, integrations, and data flows well enough to collaborate effectively with Solution Architects, Engineering, and AI/ML teams.


**Execution \& Ownership**
* Work with Project Managers and Solution Architects to move solutions from discovery into implementation.
* Translate requirements into well\-structured Jira tickets and recommend priorities based on business value, customer needs, dependencies, and project objectives.
* Define KPIs and success criteria for each workflow.
* Partner with QA to draft the test strategy and test cases, making sure everything in the BRD is covered, and support UAT and release readiness.
* Own your work end to end: surface gaps early, follow through on open questions, keep requirements current, flag requirement changes or scope creep so they can go through change control, and ensure stakeholders remain aligned.
* Handle client data responsibly in line with HIPAA and internal data\-handling policies, using de\-identified or synthetic data in requirements, mockups, and other artifacts.


**Customer \& Communication**
* Lead and participate in customer meetings with both business and technical stakeholders, communicating complex concepts clearly and confidently.
* Produce polished, customer\-ready documentation and effectively prepare deliverables for client sign\-off.
* Manage multiple customer workstreams, meetings, requirements, decisions, and follow\-ups in a fast\-moving environment.


**Must\-Have Qualifications**
* 2\-5 years of relevant professional experience in healthcare business analysis, consulting, healthtech, healthcare operations, implementation, health informatics, solutions analysis, or a related role.
* Strong knowledge of healthcare operations and direct experience working on payer processes and translating them into clear BRDs for technical teams.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and safe handling of PHI in a healthcare setting.
* Experience gathering requirements and creating BRDs, workflows, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, or similar artifacts.
* Experience designing current\-state and future\-state workflows using process\-mapping tools.
* Strong client\-facing, written, and verbal communication skills.
* Familiarity with Jira and translating business requirements into development work.
* Practical experience using AI tools in professional work and curiosity about new ways to apply AI and automation.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* A strong sense of ownership and structured curiosity \- you ask the right questions, uncover what is missing, and drive ambiguity toward clarity.
* Comfort working in a growing organization where priorities evolve and processes are continuously improved


**Bonus Points**
* Direct experience with UM, Prior Authorization, Appeals \& Grievances, Care Management, claims, clinical documentation, or related healthcare workflows.
* Experience with AI\-enabled healthcare solutions, including OCR, RAG, extraction, classification, or document understanding.
* Familiarity with FHIR/HL7, X12, or clinical terminology such as ICD\-10, CPT, or SNOMED.
* Background in healthcare consulting, implementation, or customer\-facing healthtech delivery.
* Experience building mockups or prototypes with AI tools.
* Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop AI workflows in a production setting.
